::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 1st 1883  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e 86.[^1]
:::

Dear [Charles](people/person_1043.qmd),

I think I can let you have a story called Burrs, about choir boys if you like to have it. It will be published as part of a volume called [Langley Adventures](cmy_books/cmybook_163.qmd) about Christmas but you will have the start

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘The Revd/ C Moor/Grimsby/ Lincolnshire’ and postmarked Winchester 1 October 1883.  Charles Moor (b. 1857/8) was the son of the Rev. John Frewen Moor, and was perhaps running a parish magazine.
